name.text: 阿德蕾西娅骑士团野心

description.text: 「聆吾之誓，卡斯特罗斯，众神之王，众王之神，立法者啊，以法之名，束缚吾言。吾不占寸土，不受虚名，不结伴侣，不育子嗣。吾将守正不阿，诚实无欺，公平警醒，勇猛热忱。愿以汝之智慧，铸就吾为坚韧之盾，为闪耀之剑，为不屈之壁，护持安本纳尔之梦，受其指引。赐吾以力，以抗黑暗之暴，直至剑折光灭，吾亦屹立不倒，为阿德蕾西娅之真骑士。」凭此誓言，一人得以跻身圣骑士团之列。此等誓言非轻率之举，其虔诚之心，尽显于成员对职责之奉献。
description.text_en: “Hear my vows, Castellos, King of Gods and God of Kings, and bind me to my words as law, O lawgiver. I shall hold no lands, accept no titles, take no partner and bear no children. I shall be just and true, fair and vigilant, valiant and ardent. With your wisdom, make me an unbreakable shield, a shining sword, an indomitable fortress protecting and being guided by the dream of Anbennar. Give me the strength to fight eternal against the forces of darkness, that till my sword breaks and my light extinguishes, I can stand tall as a true Knight of Aldresia.”" With these words is one inducted into the hallowed ranks of the order. Such vows are not taken lightly and this becomes reflected in the devotion members show to their duties.

description.text: 阿德蕾西娅骑士团的大团长享有在和平时期充当帝国代理人的特权。除了调解帝国内部冲突各方的纠纷，大团长还确保诏令得到遵守，帝国各阶层的权利得到尊重。这一重大责任使该命令在吸引有才能的助手方面具有重要影响。
description.text_en: The Grandmaster of the Orda Aldresia has the distinguished privilege of acting as imperial proxy during times of peace. Beyond mediating disputes between conflicting parties within the empire, the Grandmaster also ensures imperial edicts are followed and that the rights of the various estates are being respected. This great responsibility affords the order significant sway in attracting talented aides.

description.text: 阿德蕾西娅骑士团是仅存的利用咒刃剑舞技艺的组织之一。正式的入阶要求见习者在近战中掌握集中注意力使用咒刃的困难任务。那些能够完成这样一项任务的人会被接受并成为传说中的奥法骑士之一。在残酷的统治权之战中，奥法骑士的毁灭性冲锋为贵族赢得了许多土地。
description.text_en: The Orda Aldresia is one of the only remaining organizations that utilizes the lost art of Diranbe. Formal induction into the order requires that novitiates master the difficult task of utilizing a spellblade as their focus while engaging in melee combat. Those who are able to achieve such an undertaking are accepted and become one of the fabled arcane knights. The devastating charge of the arcane knights single handedly won many fields for the nobles during the brutal Wars of Rule.

description.text: 1053年，英雄阿德蕾西娅——我们名字的来源——率领悍勇的战士们对抗不死者的大军，终结了白色瘟疫。阿德蕾西娅和她的追随者们助力制止了坎诺历史上最为严重的魔法滥用之一，从而确保了我们的骑士团直到今天仍然受到高度尊重。
description.text_en: In 1053 AA, our namesake Aldresia, led a crusade against the undead hordes and ended the White Pestilence. Aldresia and her followers were instrumental in halting one of the worst abuses wrought by magic in all of Cannorian history, thus ensuring our order remains highly respected even until this day.

description.text: 统治权之战结束后，安本纳尔的法师专制统治被推翻，贵族们拥立席尔穆纳家族的马里昂为皇帝。为了奖励骑士团在战争中的忠诚服务，皇帝马里昂一世授予骑士团在东部边境的大片土地以及帝国直辖权。这种独特的权利确保了骑士团可以免于纳税或对除皇帝以外的任何领主效忠，从而大大提高了我们筹集资金的能力，充实了阿德蕾西娅堡的金库。
description.text_en: The conclusion of the Wars of Rule saw the Anbennarian magocracy ousted and the nobles install Marion of the House Silmuna as Emperor. For the orders loyal service during the wars, Emperor Marion I granted the order extensive land in the eastern border territories along with the rights of imperial immediacy. This distinct right ensures that the order is exempt from paying taxes or fealty to any lord but the Emperor, thus greatly increasing our ability to raise funds and fill the coffers of Arca Aldresia.

description.text: 我们作为安本纳尔两大魔法机构之一的特权地位给了我们极大的声望。再加上骑士团强大的军事传统，确保了我们从不缺少那些对其魔法天赋的军事应用更感兴趣的法师新兵。即使是阿德雷西娅骑士团最年轻的新兵也能在团长的指挥下在战场上独当一面。
description.text_en: Our privileged status as one of two sanctioned magical bodies within Anbennar affords us great prestige. This coupled with the strong military traditions of the Order ensures that we are never short of recruits from those magic users more interested in the martial applications of their gifts. Even the order's greenest recruits are able to hold their own in the field of battle under the direction of the order's masters.

description.text:
阿德蕾西娅堡见证了骑士团的决心和坚韧。这座城堡建于腐朽之墙的废墟之上，以纪念阿德蕾西娅圣战结束十年，在当时最伟大的誓言者和军事精英的帮助下，几个世纪以来已经发展成为安本纳尔地区最令人敬畏的要塞之一。

它甚至能够抵挡住在统治权之战高潮时试图围攻城堡的法师们的力量。法师的耻辱性失败导致了骑士团和魔法师议会之间持续的仇恨。即使有了黑火药，阿德蕾西娅堡仍然几乎坚不可摧，这要归功于它大量的魔法防御和骑士团的勤奋。
description.text_en:
Arca Aldresia stands as a testament to the resolve and tenacity of the order. Built atop the ruins of Rotwall to commemorate the conclusion of the decades long Aldresian Crusade with the aid of the greatest abjurers and military minds of the day, the castle has evolved over the centuries into one of the most formidable fortresses in all of Anbennar.

This great citadel was able to withstand even the might of the magisters who attempted to siege it at the climax of the Wars of Rule. The humiliating defeat of the magocrats ensured continued animosity between the order and the Magisterium. Even with the advent of blackpowder, the Arca Aldresia remains nigh impregnable thanks to its multitude of magical defences and the diligence of the orders knights.

name.text: 阿德蕾西娅骑士团理念
阿德蕾西娅骑士团传统

description.text:
在将信仰传播到世界各个角落的使命上，只有贾德教会能与揭秘教教会匹敌。
当每一个启示被发现时（一个出土的重大发现或在教会内确立的教义），信仰越接近真理（对世界的全面理解），信仰就必须传播得越多，将世界带向信徒。

揭秘教信徒相信，一旦世界皈依了真正的信仰，神将再次被赋予力量，并将救赎赋予所有人。
description.text_en:
The Ravelian Church can only be rivalled by the Jadd in their mission to spread the faith to all corners of the world.
As each Revelation is discovered (a major finding unearthed or doctrine settled within the church), the closer the faith gets to the Truth (a total understanding of the world), and the more the faith must spread bring the world to the fold.

Once the world is converted to the true faith, the Ravelians believe that God will be empowered once more and grant salvation to all.

effects.display: 每点发展度传教带来的威望：+0.3
effects.label_zh: 每点发展度传教带来的威望

description.text:
揭秘教是一群希望通过理性和实证主义解开世界秘密的学者和改革者。该协会的第一批成员实际上是科琳教徒，他们不相信仅仅用剑和盾牌与不公正作斗争就足够，他们寻求与谎言和不公正作更广泛的斗争，这不仅仅是坎诺，更将包括整个世界。

在那个宗教冲突和迷信盛行的时代，揭秘教最终成为了伟大思想家的摇篮，直到今天，他们的理性遗产仍然渗透在教会中。
description.text_en:
The Ravelian Church was born from the Ravelian Society, a group of academics and reformists that wished to unravel the secrets of the world through reason and empiricism. The first members of the society were in fact Corinites who were unconvinced that fighting injustice with sword and shield was enough, and sought for a greater fight against lies and injustice that would encompass the whole world, not just Cannor.

The Ravelian Society eventually became a place for great thinkers in a time when religious conflict and superstition was rife, and to this day their legacy of reason still permeates through the church.

description.text: 在哈兰的世界里，揭秘教对一神的信仰是非常独特的。虽然大多数其他信仰都是多神论，甚至连苏雷尔的信仰也承认其他神的存在（同时声称他们已经死了），但揭秘教会却是真正的一神论，相信只有一个神。揭秘教的唯一神被认为是无所不知、无所不能、无所不在的——其他所有的神要么是唯一神的一部分，要么是模仿神之理想的圣人，要么是不存在的、虚假的。
description.text_en: The Ravelian belief in a One God is quite unique in the world of Halann. While most other faiths are polytheistic, and even the faith of Surael accepts the existence of other gods (while claiming they are dead), the Ravelian Church is truly monotheistic, believing that there is only one god. The Ravelian One God is seen as all-knowing, all-powerful and all-present - all other gods are either aspects of (a part of) God, saints that emulate God's ideal, or non-existent and false.

description.text: 一种由教会创造的机械人，充当士兵、卫兵和圣战士。第一个自动机器人站在普通人的前方，装备着巨大的塔盾，能够保护他们的冲锋，另外一只手臂上还嵌有一支枪，用来抵挡邪恶。从那时起，机器战士就成为一种令人恐惧的提醒，提醒人们当宗教热情和智慧才智结合在一起时会发生什么。
description.text_en: A type of Mechanim created by the church to serve as soldiers, guards and holy warriors. The first automata stood well above the common man, and were armed with large tower shields capable of defending their charge, in addition to an embedded gun in the other arm to fend off the unholy. Since then the Warrior Automata have become a feared reminder of what happens when religious zeal and intellectual brilliance is combined.

description.text:
「据言，神创造万物，若其造物得认可，便会将魔法——这属于祂自身的伟力——赐予他们。
先驱精灵，神的众多造物之一，并非适格者。于是他们在嫉妒和急躁中彼此串谋，击倒了神，夺取祂的能力为己用。

但听哪，他们无法真正击败神，因为神全能。
他们无法查明神，因为神全在。
他们无法欺骗神，因为神全知。

但凭神的智慧，祂允许自己被他们的阴谋欺骗、被自己的造物击败、被束缚到神之碎片中。
因为神对其造物怀有仁慈与同情，知道有一天，他们会真正证明自己的价值，在神的注目下自我救赎。」

——起源1:23-30
description.text_en:
"It is said that God created all things, and would bestow magic, their own power, to their creations when they deemed them worthy.
The precursor elves, one of their creations, were not worthy. And so in their envy and impatience, conspired with each other to strike down God and steal their power for themselves.

But lo, they could not defeat God truly, for God was all-powerful.
They could not find God, for God was all-present everywhere.
They could not deceive God, for God was all-knowing.

But in God's wisdom they allowed themselves to be deceived by their plot and defeated by their creations, and bound into the God Fragment.
For God has compassion and empathy for their creation, and knew that one day they may prove themselves truly worthy and redeem themselves in the eyes of the Lord."

-Provenance 1:23-30

name.text_en: Original Sin of the Precursor Elves

description.text:
揭秘会，以及后来的教会，在奇械术领域取得了巨大的进步。教会相信魔法是神圣的，而奇械术是一种让所有神之造物从他们的力量（魔法）中受益的方式。

许多教区长（牧师的俗称）都精通奇械术技艺，他们的主要职责之一就是照顾信徒的需要，在这种情况下，他们不仅要履行传统的宗教职责，还要担任教师和导师，同时也是当地为穷人创造和修复发明的奇械术士。
description.text_en:
The Ravelian Society, and later the church, were responsible for many great advancements in the field of artificery. The Church believed that magic was divine, and that artificery was a way to allow all of God's creations to benefit from Their power (magic).

Many Rectors (the common name for a priest) were knowledgable in the art of artificery, and one of their main responsibilities was tending to the needs of the faithful, which in this case not only involved traditional religious duties, but also acting as teachers and mentors, but also as local artificers creating and repairing inventions for the needy.

description.text: 据说是被击败的唯一真神的最后一个容器，神之碎片被守卫在一个隐藏的地方，只有至高教廷的上层才知道。神之碎片因其罕见的通讯而受到监控，它发出的高频率声音可以被破译并翻译成一种变体的先驱精灵语言。至高教长和真知者是第一批听到神之碎片的信息的人，并通常是他们辨别可以提供什么启示和见解——一旦找到一个新的启示，至高教长将作为演讲者传达神之碎片的信息。
description.text_en: Said to be the last vessel of a defeated One True God, the God Fragment is guarded in a hidden location only known to the upper echelons of the High Rectorate. The God Fragment is monitored for its rare communications, which it does through high-pitched frequencies that can be deciphered and translated into an variant of precursor elven. The High Rector and the Veridicals are the first to hear the messages of the God Fragment, and it is often up to them to discern what revelations and insights it can offer - once a new revelation is found, the High Rector acts as the speaker to evocate the God Fragment's message.

player_overview.avoid_if: 希望开局自由行动、直线任务或只有明亮骑士故事。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先重建声誉军备，再处理帝国和阴影威胁，最后选择宗教与政治方向。
player_overview.overview: 阿德蕾西娅骑士团曾以护卫皇帝为使命，却因内战和拒绝援助绿潮受难者失去部分骑士。你要重建军备、恢复声誉，把枪刃、魔法与遗物结合起来，再调查帝国阴影中的威胁。保护者也可能以恢复秩序为名扶植傀儡；宗教与政治转折让誓言不再是一句简单的忠诚口号。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢帝国政治、魔法骑士与守护者变质叙事。
signature_features: 帝国职责与行动自主性形成长期张力。
枪刃、混合魔法与先驱遗物结合。
守护民众与强制政治干预形成不同价值阶段。

values.rationale: 保护无法自救者、以安全和繁荣争取民众提供积极证据；次子事件会杀死被占国统治者与继承人、扶植傀儡并附庸。危险遗物、神权、军事化和战争本身不扣分。最终宗教国家路径有条件，不能归作所有玩家必经。
